HAB.1.1-2.text: Habakkuk asks the LORD how long he must cry for help

HAB.1.3-4.text: Habakkuk asks why God allows violence and injustice

HAB.1.5-7.text: The LORD says he is raising up the Chaldeans

HAB.1.8-9.text: The Chaldean army is fast and full of violence

HAB.1.10-11.text: The Chaldeans laugh at kings and fortresses

HAB.1.12-12.text: Habakkuk says the LORD chose the Chaldeans to judge

HAB.1.13-14.text: Habakkuk asks why God is silent about the wicked

HAB.1.15-17.text: Habakkuk asks if the enemy will keep killing nations

HAB.2.1-1.text: Habakkuk waits to hear how the LORD will answer

HAB.2.2-3.text: The LORD tells Habakkuk to write the vision and wait

HAB.2.4-5.text: The proud are not upright, but the righteous live by faith

HAB.2.6-8.text: The Chaldeans will be robbed as they robbed others

HAB.2.9-11.text: Woe to those who build a house with unjust gain

HAB.2.12-14.text: Woe to those who build cities by bloodshed

HAB.2.15-16.text: Woe to those who make neighbors drunk and ashamed

HAB.2.17-17.text: Violence against Lebanon will come back on the Chaldeans

HAB.2.18-20.text: Idols are useless, but the LORD is in his holy temple

HAB.3.1-2.text: Habakkuk prays that the LORD will show mercy in wrath

HAB.3.3-3.text: God comes from Teman, and his glory fills the earth

HAB.3.4-5.text: God shines like sunlight, and plague goes before him

HAB.3.6-6.text: God measures the earth, and mountains crumble

HAB.3.7-8.text: Habakkuk sees nations tremble and asks about God’s anger

HAB.3.9-10.text: Habakkuk says the earth and mountains shake before God

HAB.3.11-12.text: Sun and moon stand still as God marches in fury

HAB.3.13-13.text: God goes out to save his people and crush the wicked

HAB.3.14-15.text: God destroys the enemy leader and tramples the sea

HAB.3.16-16.text: Habakkuk trembles and will wait for the day of distress

HAB.3.17-17.text: Habakkuk describes failing crops and empty stalls

HAB.3.18-19.text: Habakkuk will rejoice in God, who gives him strength
